|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd project
|denv: loading .envrc
|denv: +DENV_TEST_VAR
|testuser@<HOST> ~/project $ denv allow
|denv: allowed <HOME>/project/.envrc
|denv: loading .envrc
|denv: +DENV_TEST_VAR
|testuser@<HOST> ~/project $ denv reload
|denv: loading .envrc
|denv: +DENV_TEST_VAR
|testuser@<HOST> ~/project $
